body.authority_boundary: The mesh branch remains a non-merge transport projection; admission, acknowledgement, authority, and completion remain distinct.
body.finding: Remote bytes at previously seen event IDs were skipped before validation, and successful writes were marked synchronized before exact readback.
fixes: Validate current remote bytes even when EventGraph already contains the event ID.
Quarantine event-ID rebinding with both content addresses; never overwrite.
Require byte-identical remote readback before synced and persist retry/collision/refusal attempts.
Refuse structured raw provider payload and authority-grant fields on import and export.

subject: Existing IDs and successful writes no longer bypass byte validation
